capabilities: Writes a weekly letter note from vault notes
Flags duplicate titles, unlinked related notes and overdue reviews
Compares saved clippings with own writing
extras: Not yet in the community directory; installed by hand from release files. AI is off by default and no network request is made without it. A separate Mind Letter agent skill covers letters across several sources such as Notion.
problem: Patterns across a vault, such as recurring topics, contradicting notes, unlinked related notes and a saved-versus-written imbalance, are hard to spot when you are the one writing the notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin runs the claude program on your computer with all tools turned off
Text goes only to a server on this computer (localhost).

requires.name: Cloud API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini)

summary: Rule-based generator that reads your vault notes once a week and writes a short linked letter of themes, contradictions and loose threads.
